authorization: Researcher prioritizes decoding phase transitions and correction thresholds in the continuing Lab 008 study.
question: Can physical average minority mass be controlled directly, without collision reweighting, by a renormalized charge-preserving switch or a full-record conditional-entropy decomposition?
claim_boundary: The collision route is closed at its registered scope because its natural high-dimensional comparison loses with charge dimension. This contract returns to the physical law p(Q) and does not reuse collision-weighted overlap as a proxy for Bayes risk.
alternatives: Construct an annular or strip-scale charge-preserving logical switch and bound its congestion after retaining the full external boundary-charge record.
Decompose physical conditional logical entropy or minority mass across nested revealed charge sigma-fields and identify a scale-local positive contribution that survives conditioning.
Construct a compatible physical square-lattice obstruction showing that both direct routes can fail despite RSW crossings and finite normalized matching.
planned_steps: Audit primary renormalization, switching, martingale and conditional-entropy results against the full-charge physical expectation rather than a collision-biased law.
Write the weakest direct physical-risk inequality for each branch and test only its exact interface on L3/L4 controls.
Stop at one proved direct reduction, one compatible physical obstruction, or an explicit theorem-hypothesis gap.
acceptance_criteria: Every branch is expressed under the physical charge law p(Q), with no collision reweighting or fitted size trend.
Any proposed switch retains the full boundary charge record and states its averaged congestion measure explicitly.
Any entropy route states the conditioning sigma-fields and proves the direction of every data-processing or martingale inequality used.
The result stops at a proved reduction, compatible obstruction, or named missing hypothesis and promotes no threshold claim.
observed_findings: A direct Cauchy-Schwarz reduction gives R_L >= A_L^2/(2^E sum_y m_y^2)=(A_L/2^E)/kappa_L for a full-record majority-to-minority selector, avoiding collision reweighting and worst-case congestion.

The lower/upper extremal selectors give exact direct risk certificates 3969/14080 at L3 and 1587690075/9985196032 or 1587690075/9983885312 at L4. Their effective size-biased multiplicities are 110/63 and 76181/23005 or 76171/23005; these are controls, not a size trend.

For the frozen natural charge order, Bayes risk and conditional logical entropy remain 1/2 and one bit until the final charge at both L3 and L4, so the entropy chain rule alone does not distribute a local positive floor.
Canonical L4 contains a finite physical imbalance mechanism, but neither it nor the abstract K_(1,M) model constructs an asymptotic square family of controlled physical mass.
decision_boundary: The direct reduction is proved, but no size-uniform bound on kappa_L, no asymptotic physical obstruction family, and no midpoint or threshold conclusion is established.
stop_rule: Do not enumerate L5, fit a trend, or infer midpoint noncorrectability. Stop after the bounded three-branch matrix determines whether a direct physical-risk reduction is available under existing hypotheses.
